# Alan Breckon

Alan Breckon is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1993.

Alan Breckon has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-breckon#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 unopposed.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-breckon#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of St Saviour No 2 with 64.9% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alan-breckon#e10)

  Elected as Senator with 42.2% of the ballot.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/alan-breckon.html)
